skill.name: literature-review
skill.description: Conduct systematic literature reviews across scientific databases, synthesize evidence, verify citations, and generate structured Markdown or PDF reports.
skill.summary: Plan, search, synthesize, and format systematic literature reviews with verified citations.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The review found no prompt injection, malicious intent, data exfiltration, or hidden obfuscation. Most static findings are Markdown examples or expected academic reference links, while the confirmed risks are limited to local file writes and PDF generation through external tools.

remediation.issue: PDF generation invokes local Pandoc and LaTeX tooling on user-provided Markdown files.
remediation.suggestion: Run PDF generation only on trusted documents, keep Pandoc and LaTeX updated, and avoid processing untrusted Markdown in privileged directories.

remediation.issue: Search result processing writes to a user-supplied output path.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict output paths to the working directory or prompt for confirmation before overwriting existing files.

remediation.issue: Citation verification writes a derived report file next to the input Markdown document.
remediation.suggestion: Warn before overwriting an existing citation report and document where the report will be saved.

content.value_statement: Researchers need repeatable methods for finding, screening, and synthesizing scientific literature. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through database searches, citation checks, and professional review documents.
actual_capabilities: Structures literature reviews with planning, search, screening, synthesis, and quality assessment phases.
Provides guidance for PubMed, bioRxiv, arXiv, Semantic Scholar, and specialized biomedical databases.
Processes exported search results by deduplicating, filtering, ranking, and formatting them.
Verifies DOI citations through DOI and CrossRef services and creates a citation report.
Generates Markdown review drafts and can convert them to PDF through Pandoc when dependencies exist.
Includes templates for search documentation, PRISMA-style flow counts, and citation styles.
limitations: It does not independently access paywalled full text unless the user provides access.
Database searches depend on external APIs, rate limits, and any configured companion skills.
Citation verification only checks metadata sources and cannot prove study quality.
PDF generation requires local Pandoc and LaTeX tools to be installed.

use_cases.title: Plan a systematic biomedical review
use_cases.description: Define a PICO question, choose databases, document inclusion criteria, and prepare a reproducible search strategy.

use_cases.title: Synthesize evidence for a manuscript
use_cases.description: Organize findings by theme, compare study quality, identify gaps, and draft a clear literature review section.

use_cases.title: Verify citations before submission
use_cases.description: Extract DOIs from a review, validate metadata, format references, and produce a correction report.

prompt_templates.title: Start a review plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning a first literature review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a literature review on [topic]. Define the research question, scope, inclusion criteria, exclusion criteria, and three databases to search.

prompt_templates.title: Build database search strings
prompt_templates.prompt: Create search strings for PubMed, arXiv, and Semantic Scholar for [research question]. Include synonyms, Boolean logic, date limits, and documentation fields.

prompt_templates.title: Synthesize screened studies
prompt_templates.scenario: User has selected papers and needs analysis.
prompt_templates.prompt: Using these included studies and notes, organize a thematic synthesis. Compare evidence quality, identify consensus, and list unresolved research gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Finalize a submission-ready review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced user preparing a complete report.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my draft literature review for methodology completeness, citation consistency, PRISMA-style reporting, limitations, and PDF readiness. Provide prioritized fixes.

output_examples.input: Plan a review about CRISPR therapies for sickle cell disease.
output_examples.output: A structured plan with a PICO question, search concepts, database list, date range, inclusion criteria, exclusion criteria, and screening workflow.

output_examples.input: Synthesize these 25 screened papers into themes.
Check whether my citations are ready for journal submission.
output_examples.output: A citation quality report covering DOI validation, missing metadata, inconsistent styles, failed lookups, and recommended corrections.

best_practices: Define the research question and eligibility criteria before searching databases.
Record every search string, database, date, and result count for reproducibility.
Verify citations and review failed DOI lookups before generating final outputs.
anti_patterns: Do not rely on one database for a systematic or scoping review.
Do not summarize papers one by one when a thematic synthesis is required.
Do not treat preprints or low-quality studies as equal to peer-reviewed evidence.

faq.question: Can this skill perform a full systematic review?
faq.answer: It provides the workflow, templates, and helper scripts. Human review is still required for screening decisions and evidence appraisal.

faq.question: Which databases does it support?
faq.answer: It gives guidance for PubMed, bioRxiv, arXiv, Semantic Scholar, Google Scholar, OpenAlex, and specialized biomedical databases.

faq.question: Does it verify citations automatically?
faq.answer: It includes a citation verifier that extracts DOIs, checks DOI resolution, queries CrossRef, and writes a report.

faq.question: Can it create a PDF?
faq.answer: Yes, if Pandoc and a LaTeX engine are installed locally. The PDF helper converts Markdown into a formatted document.

faq.question: Does it replace expert judgment?
faq.answer: No. Researchers must validate search scope, screening choices, study quality, and final conclusions.

faq.question: Can Claude Code use this skill safely?
faq.answer: Yes, but users should review commands before running scripts that write files, call external APIs, or generate PDFs.
